title: Chemokine Expression in Nummular Dermatitis and Atopic Dermatitis
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to measure the serum levels of CCL17, CCL18, CCL22 and CXCL10 and their expression levels in epidermis in AD and ND patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age:20\~40, atopic dermatitis, BSA\>10%, no asthma
* age:20\~40, nummular patches\>10, no atopy

Exclusion Criteria:

* systemic immunosuppresive agents within 4 weeks
* high dose topical immunosuppresive agents within 4 weeks
study_population:
patients with atopic dermatitis

patients with nummular eczema without atopy
